title: Autonomous Pipeline Monitoring — proposed panels

content.json:
# Autonomous Pipeline Monitoring
Pipeline health, activity performance and Data Flow output counts from Azure Monitor Logs. Quality report JSON is stored separately in Blob Storage and is linked by path only; this Workbook does not read or render blob JSON.

content.title: Pipeline Runs — Last 7 Days
content.query:
ADFPipelineRun
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by RunId
| summarize TotalRuns=count(), SuccessfulRuns=countif(Status == 'Succeeded'), FailedRuns=countif(Status == 'Failed')

content.title: Pipeline Failures Over Time
content.query:
let failures =
    ADFPipelineRun
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) and Status == 'Failed'
    | summarize FailedRuns=count() by TimeGenerated=bin(TimeGenerated, 1h);
range TimeGenerated from bin(ago(7d), 1h) to bin(now(), 1h) step 1h
| join kind=leftouter failures on TimeGenerated
| project TimeGenerated, FailedRuns=coalesce(FailedRuns, 0)
| sort by TimeGenerated asc
| render timechart

content.title: Successful Activity Performance and Data Flow Output Counts
content.query:
ADFActivityRun
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by ActivityRunId
| where Status == 'Succeeded'
| extend output=parse_json(tostring(Output))
| extend acquisitionMs=tolong(output['runStatus']['computeAcquisitionDuration']), billable=parse_json(tostring(output['billingReference']['billableDuration'])), validRows=toint(output['runStatus']['metrics']['sinkValidRecords']['rowsWritten']), invalidRows=toint(output['runStatus']['metrics']['sinkInvalidRecords']['rowsWritten'])
| extend billableFirst=billable[0]
| project TimeGenerated, PipelineRunId, PipelineName, ActivityName, DurationSeconds=round(datetime_diff('second', End, Start), 1), ComputeAcquisitionSeconds=iff(isnotnull(acquisitionMs), round(todouble(acquisitionMs)/1000.0, 1), real(null)), BillableDuration=todouble(billableFirst.duration), BillableUnit=tostring(billableFirst.unit), ValidRows=validRows, InvalidRows=invalidRows
| order by TimeGenerated desc
